probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://westgermany.de/ (the only candidate official domain found, matching the venue's own contact email domain per WebSearch discovery-lead context) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden from an openresty edge, with a response body containing the well-known 'padding to disable MSIE and Chrome friendly error page' comment pattern that indicates a deliberate anti-bot/edge block rather than a genuine application error. This reads as an explicit access-control boundary, not a transient or content-specific failure — per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md this terminates escalation; the correct next step is DEFER, not attempting to defeat the block.

blockers.description: The only candidate official domain (westgermany.de) returns a consistent edge-level HTTP 403 Forbidden (openresty anti-bot pattern) on every path, protocol, subdomain, and User-Agent tried. No page content, event data, or platform fingerprint of any kind could be retrieved, and no alternative first-party domain was found via WebSearch. Per policy, this is an explicit access-control boundary that must not be worked around (no CAPTCHA-defeat, no header/fingerprint spoofing beyond a plain descriptive UA, no evasive technique).

reasons: The only candidate official domain returns a consistent, edge-level HTTP 403 Forbidden across every protocol/subdomain/User-Agent/path combination tried — a genuine access-control boundary (BLOCKED), not a transient error.
identity.status is honestly AMBIGUOUS: the domain-to-contact-email match is plausible but was never corroborated against actual rendered page content, because no content was ever retrievable.

No alternative first-party domain exists per multiple WebSearch queries — every other source found (Songkick, Dice.fm, Resident Advisor, clubguideberlin.de, bpigs.com, Instagram) is either a third-party aggregator/ticketing site or lists no website at all.

Per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md 'The escalation ladder': BLOCKED terminates escalation and the correct next step is DEFER or HUMAN_REVIEW, never an attempt to bypass the block. DEFER does not require exhausting the ladder — a single BLOCKED Level 1 entry followed by DEFER is explicitly a valid, complete investigation outcome.

This investigation should be revisited later (a new investigation_id, superseding this one) if the block condition changes or a genuine alternative first-party domain/social channel with a public events feed is found.
